meta.title: User Activity / Audit Log: refused for a user without the Tenant Admin role
gaps: Sign in as a non-Tenant Admin and a Tenant Admin on the same Enterprise tenant, open User Activity / Audit Log, and verify that the non-admin is refused or does not see it while the Tenant Admin can access it.
the plan has no assertion step — nothing the case checks can be observed
warnings: cannot test this case yet — the plan has no assertion step — nothing the case checks can be observed

args.need: sign in as a non-Tenant Admin and a Tenant Admin on the same Enterprise tenant, open User Activity / Audit Log for each, and verify that access is refused or absent for the non-admin but available to the Tenant Admin

steps.note: The catalog cannot perform the required role-specific sign-ins or observe the User Activity / Audit Log access decision.
